en: During the First Purification of Hab Spire Legis on Meridian, a young boy felled a large ganger with a simple laspistol just as the criminal was readying an ambush on a Blood Raven. Stray shots scarred the Space Marine's armor, which still bears those marks as a reminder of the simple child's courage.
zh_new: 在梅里迪安萊吉斯居住尖塔第一次淨化期間，一名年輕男孩用一把簡陋激光手槍擊倒了一名高大幫派分子，當時那名罪犯正準備伏擊一名血鴉。流彈在星際戰士裝甲上留下傷痕，而這些痕跡至今仍提醒著人們那個普通孩子的勇氣。
